0.long_answer: Sirolimus, also known as rapamycin, is a macrolide compound originally derived from a fungus. Unlike calcineurin inhibitors such as ciclosporin which are well known to increase blood pressure, sirolimus is associated with adverse effects like hypercholesterolemia (increased blood cholesterol) but is less likely to cause hypertension. This difference in side effect profiles helps differentiate between these two fungal-derived immunosuppressive agents.
